title: lantana triplinervia var. puberulenta
intro: Lantana triplinervia var. puberulenta, commonly known as the Panamint lantana or rough button lantana, is a plant species in the verbena family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Lantana triplinervia var. puberulenta include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids.
